paper_metadata.title: A review of microstructure control and mechanical performance optimization of γ-TiAl alloys

evidence.quote: γ-TiAl alloys are titanium aluminides with the Al content of 42–49 at.% (atomic percent), which are considered as important substitutes for titanium alloys and nickel-based superalloys in aero engines.

Besides, much attention has also been paid to poly-synthetically twinned TiAl (PST-TiAl) single crystal with a service temperature up to 900 ℃ [8]. The PST-TiAl single crystal with controlled lamellar orientations was prepared by directional solidification.
